SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in an IPv6 literal

```elixir title="Elixir"
try do
  engine_config = "{\"ssrf\":{\"deny_private\":true},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}"
  {:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
  url = "http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/"
  result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
rescue
  error -> IO.puts(:stderr, "#{inspect(error.__struct__)}: #{Exception.message(error)}")
end
```
